settings_description: Manage global parameters, infrastructure, and artificial intelligence channels.
system_email_smtp_desc: Dedicated SMTP server with authentication and TLS/SSL support
system_email_resend_desc: Managed transactional email delivery via Resend API
system_storage_s3_desc: Cloud storage compatible with AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, or MinIO
system_storage_local_desc: Local disk storage persisted directly on the application server
system_captcha_provider_turnstile_desc: Fast and accessible Cloudflare challenge with no interactive visual puzzles
system_captcha_provider_recaptcha_v3_des: Fully invisible background risk analysis based on scoring
system_captcha_provider_recaptcha_v2_des: Classic Google challenge with 'I am not a robot' checkbox and image selection
system_captcha_provider_hcaptcha_desc: Privacy-focused alternative with visual classification challenges
system_ai_provider_anthropic_desc: Claude models (Sonnet, Haiku) featuring advanced reasoning and large context windows
system_ai_provider_openai_desc: OpenAI GPT-4o models for general tasks, chat, and reasoning
system_ai_provider_openai_compatible_des: Local servers or compatible endpoints (Ollama, vLLM, Groq)
system_captcha_sitekey_invalid: Site key rejected by the provider, or the challenge was not completed. Check the key and the registered domain.
system_captcha_provider_unavailable: Captcha provider unavailable. Reload the page and try again.
system_captcha_enabled_desc: Controls whether captcha is required on login, signup and password recovery.
system_captcha_provider_desc: Turnstile and hCaptcha draw a widget; reCAPTCHA v3 is invisible and fails by score.
system_captcha_site_key_desc: Public key, handed to the browser to draw the widget.
system_captcha_secret_key_desc: Private key, used only for server-to-server verification. Never leaves the backend.
system_oauth_redirect_uri: Register {url} as the redirect URL in the provider. Leave the credentials blank to hide the button on the login screen.
system_oauth_issuer_desc: Base URL of the OpenID Connect provider — the one publishing /.well-known/openid-configuration.
system_oauth_issuer_desc_google: Use https://accounts.google.com. The same for any Google account, no variation.
system_oauth_issuer_desc_microsoft: Use https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/v2.0. Replace "common" with your tenant ID to allow only accounts from your organization.
system_oauth_client_id_desc: Application identifier registered in the provider
systemconfig_log_limite_desc: Number of records to keep in the system
systemconfig_log_delete_day_desc: Number of days records will be kept in the system
systemconfig_sendlog_desc: Enable sending logs to the support team
systemconfig_sistemId_desc: Unique identifier for the system (used for authorization)
monitoring_providers_intro: Integrations for telemetry, error diagnostics, and technical support forwarding.
system_support_provider_desc: Automated delivery of logs and diagnostics to the customer support center.
system_support_modal_desc: Define endpoint and integration credentials for the support center.
system_sentry_provider_desc: Real-time error monitoring and exception tracking.
systemconfig_sentry_intro: The DSN is validated against the Sentry server before being stored — nothing is saved if the key is rejected. The checkbox turns reporting on and off without erasing the DSN, including when it comes from the SENTRY_DSN environment variable. Requires a backend restart to take effect.
systemconfig_sentry_dsn_desc: Sentry project DSN that 5xx errors are reported to. Empty means no destination configured
user_system_definitions_defaults: These settings are the default settings for new users
user_system_definitions_tour_desc: Show the system tutorial to new users
system_definitions_theme_desc: Default theme applied to new users
system_user_create_desc: Allow users to create their own accounts
system_email_provider_desc: Select the email provider to be used by the system
system_email_provider_api_key_desc: API key for the selected email provider
system_email_default_from_desc: Default 'from' email address used when sending emails
system_email_templates_desc: HTML sent for each email type. Variables in double curly braces, such as the recipient's name, are substituted and always escaped on send.
system_email_template_using_override: Using the custom HTML saved here.
system_email_template_save_error: Template configuration not loaded yet. Try again in a moment.
system_ai_provider_desc: Select the AI provider to be used by the system
system_ai_anthropic_api_key_desc: API key for the Anthropic provider
system_ai_anthropic_model_desc: Anthropic model used by the AI agent
system_ai_openai_api_key_desc: API key for the OpenAI provider
system_ai_openai_model_desc: OpenAI model used by the AI agent
system_ai_openai_compatible_base_url_des: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible providers (e.g., Ollama, LM Studio)
system_ai_system_prompt_desc: Global instructions for the AI agent (applied to all users)
system_agent_own_key_desc: When enabled, each user configures their own API key in the agent
byok_active_note: With BYOK on, each user configures their own provider, model and key in Profile → Agent configuration.
userconfig_agent_api_key_desc: Your personal API key for the AI agent
userconfig_agent_prompt_desc: Personal instructions concatenated to the global prompt in your conversations
system_storage_provider_desc: Select the storage provider to be used by the system
system_storage_s3_endpoint_desc: S3 endpoint URL (AWS, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, etc.)
system_storage_s3_bucket_desc: Name of the bucket where files will be stored
system_storage_s3_public_url_desc: Public base URL to access bucket files
system_storage_local_dir_desc: Path of the directory where files will be stored locally
system_storage_public_base_url_desc: Server base URL for serving local files
system_storage_step_connection_desc: Endpoint, region, bucket and public URL
secret_keep_blank: Leave blank to keep the current credential
system_messaging_provider_desc: Choose how WhatsApp messages are sent. Credentials are validated against the provider before being saved.
system_messaging_instance_description: Generated by the system on save and created in Evolution. Not editable: the name binds the system to the provider.
messaging_connections_desc: Each connection is a WhatsApp number reached through a provider. The number is set on the first pairing and never changes: when reconnecting, use the same number.
messaging_connection_no_number: Number set on the first pairing
messaging_connection_default_locked: Already the default connection. Pick another one to switch.
messaging_connection_archive_hint: Takes the connection out of use and frees its number, keeping the history. This is how you switch provider or number.
messaging_connection_archive_confirm_des: It stops being used and frees the number for another connection, and the instance is deleted on the provider — both irreversible. The conversation history stays readable.
messaging_connection_choose_action_desc: We found archived connection(s) for this provider. You can restore an earlier connection to preserve its message history and conversations with the same number, or create a new connection.
messaging_connection_action_restore_desc: Reactivates the connection keeping message history and conversations. The phone number must match the previously registered one.
messaging_connection_action_create_new_d: Starts a fresh connection with the provider.
messaging_connection_archived_list_title: Select an archived connection to restore
messaging_connection_restore_confirm_des: The connection will be reactivated. When pairing WhatsApp, you must use the same phone number previously registered.
messaging_session_qrcode_desc: Scan the QR Code with WhatsApp on your phone to connect this instance.
system_messaging_step_credentials_desc: Validated against the provider on save
system_messaging_step_pair_desc: Pair by scanning the QR code
system_messaging_webhook_public_url_desc: Development only: the tunnel URL pointing at the FRONTEND (e.g. https://your-tunnel.com). Empty uses the app's public host. Applies to every connection.
system_messaging_phone_number_id_invalid: Digits only. This is Meta's "Phone number ID" (e.g. 106540352242922), not the phone number itself.
system_messaging_graph_version_invalid: Use the format v21.0 (letter v, number, dot, number).
system_messaging_app_id_invalid: The App ID is digits only.
system_messaging_waba_id_required: Enter the WhatsApp Business Account ID (WABA).
system_messaging_waba_id_invalid: Digits only. This is Meta's "WhatsApp Business Account ID".
system_messaging_tour_hint: Not sure where to find these values?
system_messaging_tour_phoneNumberId: At developers.facebook.com open your app → WhatsApp → API Setup. Copy the "Phone number ID" (digits only). It is not the phone number.
system_messaging_tour_graphVersion: Meta API version in the v21.0 format. When in doubt, keep the suggested value.
system_messaging_tour_appId: At developers.facebook.com → your app → App settings → Basic → "App ID". Needed to register the webhook automatically.
system_messaging_tour_wabaId: In API Setup, right below the number, or in WhatsApp Manager (business.facebook.com). Required to create and approve templates.
system_messaging_tour_accessToken: At business.facebook.com/settings → Users → System users, generate a token with the whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management permissions. The temporary test token expires in 24 hours.
system_messaging_tour_appSecret: At developers.facebook.com → your app → App settings → Basic → "App secret" (click Show). Used to verify webhooks really come from Meta.
system_messaging_tour_verifyToken: Any text you make up (e.g. a long passphrase). Meta sends it back when validating the webhook and the system checks it matches.
system_messaging_ignore_desc: Numbers in this list are dropped by the webhook: nothing is stored or answered.
system_messaging_ignore_invalid: Invalid number for the selected country.
system_messaging_ignore_duplicate: This number is already on the list.
system_messaging_ignore_save_error: Could not save the ignore list.
system_log_min_level_desc: Nothing below this level is stored. DEBUG stores everything; INFO drops login and agent-usage noise; WARN keeps audit events only.
system_storage_tour_hint: Do not know where to find these values?
system_storage_tour_endpoint: In your AWS, Cloudflare R2, or MinIO dashboard, provide the service URL (e.g., https://s3.amazonaws.com or your MinIO/R2 endpoint).
system_storage_tour_region: The region where your bucket was created (e.g., us-east-1, sa-east-1, or auto for Cloudflare R2).
system_storage_tour_bucket: The unique name of the bucket created to store uploaded system files.
system_storage_tour_publicUrl: The public base URL configured so the browser can display uploaded images and assets.
system_storage_tour_accessKey: In your AWS IAM (or MinIO/R2 dashboard), create an access key with read/write permissions for the bucket.
system_storage_tour_secretKey: The secret key corresponding to the Access Key ID. Keep it safe.
system_captcha_tour_hint: Do not know where to find these values?
system_captcha_tour_siteKey: Public key obtained from the Cloudflare (Turnstile), Google (reCAPTCHA v3), or hCaptcha dashboard when registering your domain.
system_captcha_tour_secretKey: Secret key obtained from the captcha provider dashboard. Used by the backend to verify challenge tokens.
system_ai_tour_hint: Do not know where to find these values?
system_ai_tour_apiKey: In the provider console (platform.openai.com or console.anthropic.com), create a new key under API Keys with active billing.
system_ai_tour_model: Select or enter the model identifier (e.g., gpt-4o, claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022).
system_ai_tour_baseUrl: Required for OpenAI Compatible providers (e.g., Ollama http://localhost:11434/v1 or LM Studio).
tour_settings_intro: Here you customize global security settings, limits, and system parameters.
tour_settings_email: Configure your email service (SMTP or external providers) for sending invitations and alerts.
tour_settings_storage: Define where uploaded files and photos are stored (Locally, AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, or MinIO).
tour_settings_captcha: Enable and configure anti-bot protection services (Cloudflare Turnstile, hCaptcha, or reCAPTCHA).
tour_settings_oauth: Manage social authentication providers (Google, GitHub, etc.) for simplified login.
tour_settings_notification: Configure channels and preferences for sending system notifications via email or WhatsApp.
tour_settings_messaging: Connect WhatsApp Business channels (Meta Cloud API or Evolution) for automated messaging.
tour_settings_ai: Manage artificial intelligence providers (OpenAI, Anthropic) and customize the Agent behavior.
